findings.title: Offsite verification passes vacuously on an empty or unexpectedly tiny snapshot repository

findings.remediation: Fail when the local repository has fewer than a minimum file count (or shrinks more than a configured fraction); make a missing repo a hard failure for both targets; assert total>0 before verification and before writing state; add an offline test for empty/missing/shrunk repositories.
findings.note: New 2026-11-08. P2 defense-in-depth; the original path trigger is fixed and live backups are healthy. The empty-repo case is the demonstrable vacuous pass.
